analysis:
The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md: it bumps the 'Last updated' date and adds a new section (head lines ~4816-4826) describing GPT-OSS decode Metal command buffer commit granularity (every 100 ops, no input-size bound) through CBv2DecodeCommandBufferLimitsProviding. The supplied units are unchanged base excerpts (lines 1645-2464) covering scheduler config, deadlines, MTP, sampling, reasoning and tool parsing. They contain no patch hunks.

The security-relevant behavior reviewed is that the documentation describes a performance tuning of GPU command buffer partitioning. It states that results do not depend on partitioning and that prefill keeps MLX defaults. No security control, authorization, attestation, encryption, key handling, prefix-cache (T-041), coordinator/provider wire, or data-exposure behavior is changed or described as changed in the visible evidence. No threat assumption is invalidated. The prefix-cache and TTFT oracle discussion (T-041, SEC-035) is unaffected, though faster decode could marginally alter timing. That is not a regression of any stated control.

Remaining integration questions: the actual code implementing GPTOSSDecodeCommandBuffers is outside this batch, so the doc claim (e.g. bounded in-flight command buffers and memory) cannot be verified here. Any availability or memory impact (T-029, T-010) would depend on that unseen code. Documentation-only changes in this evidence do not constitute a finding.
